title: Creamy, Comforting Carrot Potato Soup
summary: Nothing says cozy like a warm bowl of this creamy Carrot Potato Soup! It's hearty, comforting, and incredibly easy to make, perfect when you need a nourishing pick-me-up.
steps: Start by sautéing onions and garlic, then toss in carrots, potatoes, celery, and a sprinkle of Italian herbs.
Add veggie broth and bay leaves, then let it simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend half for that creamy texture, stir it back in, season to taste, and let it simmer a few more minutes.
Serve it warm and enjoy every cozy, comforting spoonful.
